nom: Essence Glow Like Honey Serum Spray

avis.titre: Just the glow you needJust the glow you need
avis.texte: This essence Glow Like Honey Serum Spray works as advertised. After a vigorous shake, you spray it on your face and get a nice healthy glow. It's a combo of oil and water phases, so I'd caution oilier skin types on adding an extra layer of oil. I have combination skin with an oilier T-zone, so I prefer to try to keep this on my cheeks to even out my glow. It does have a scent that I'm assuming is honey. It's not bad but it's not my favorite. I do think at $5.99, this is a great value.

This is a great inexpensive option for serum. It's very easy to apply. It has a lovely sweet scent, and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated and glowy. The bottle is cute and compact. The product mixes oil and water, but it doesn't leave a greasy residue on my face, nor does it cause breakouts. Instead, my skin just looks refreshed with a more youthful glow. At my age, I really appreciate that! I know that this brand is one of the more affordable options, and this serum fits right in there. You get quite a bit of serum spray for less than $6.

avis.titre: Decent glowy spray, but not perfect
avis.texte: Decent scent, spray is a bit spotty, not as fine a mist as other products like the d’alba first serum spray. It takes a few minutes to dry down and gives a definite glow.
The serum is nice the only down fall is the smell, kinda smells like cheesy feet or something similar.
Creates a nice glow on your face, however, I can't take the smell. It's so strong, it makes me gag!! I wish they hadn't included such a horrible smell!

avis.titre: Wanted to love, misses the mark
avis.texte: I was so excited for this spray. I love essence and I've been wanting to jump on the glowy skin trend. The pros: it applied evenly and dried quickly. It feels good going on. The cons: The dewy finish is barely there. I honestly didn't notice any major change to my complexion. I'm also sad to report I can't stand the smell to the point that I stopped using it. It felt like a lifetime for the fragrance to dissipate. I imagine there are those that will enjoy this product, but for me this is not it.
Love the glow this gives but I absolutely hate the smell so much that I can’t wear it! Not repurchasing.
What a stunning product! This is great to prep the skin before makeup, to apply between layers, to freshen up the face, and to set makeup. It reminds me a lot of the viral d'Alba First Serum Spray.
Makes the skin glow. And look refreshed. Looks even better when spraying on make up
Absolutely love the honey smell, and the actual product is so hydrating. Leaving your skin with a glow and feeling hydrated & supple.

avis.titre: I prefer to use it as a body spray
avis.texte: The scent on this essence Glow Like Honey Serum Spray, Dewy Face Mist, Vegan & Cruelty Free is quite strong. I smell as if I fell into a bowl of cupcake batter. The honey scent is very strong along with something I perceive to be vanilla. One spray is enough for full coverage. I use it more as a body spray rather than using it on my face. I dab it in just a bit so I can pat a bit up around my neck if I wanted added scent that isn't muffled by clothing.

avis.titre: Smells like dessert and feels great on my face!
avis.texte: I really like this essence Glow Like Honey Serum Spray. It feels hydrating on my face and is very refreshing. The smell is light and not overwhelming at all. It reminds me of yummy dessert. 🤤 At first I was alarmed by the separation of the ingredients (as shown in my picture), but it appears to be normal and the bottle clearly states to shake first. It does contain soybean oil which is great for skin. I was also concerned it would leave an oily feeling on my face but it actually soaks in nicely with no greasy residue. The bottle is fairly small and I do wish it were glass, but the mist comes out evenly with no mess so I have no complaints. The price is great too!
